# devin_enterprise_service_user_api_key (Resource)

Manages an API key of an existing service user. The token is returned by the API only when the key is created, so it is stored in Terraform state (as a sensitive value) and the resource cannot be imported. API keys cannot be changed in place: any change creates a new key and revokes the old one. Set `lifecycle { create_before_destroy = true }` to create the new key before the old one is revoked. A key that was revoked outside Terraform or has expired is removed from state, so the next apply creates a new one. Destroying this resource revokes the key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "devin_service_users" "all" {}

locals {
  ci_service_user_id = one([
    for su in data.devin_service_users.all.service_users : su.service_user_id
    if su.name == "CI Pipeline"
  ])
}

# A key that does not expire.
resource "devin_enterprise_service_user_api_key" "ci" {
  service_user_id = local.ci_service_user_id
  name            = "ci"
}

# Rotate a key every 30 days (uses the hashicorp/time provider). Each new key
# is created before the old one is revoked and expires after 60 days.
resource "time_rotating" "ci" {
  rotation_days = 30
}

resource "devin_enterprise_service_user_api_key" "rotating" {
  service_user_id = local.ci_service_user_id
  name            = "ci-${formatdate("YYYY-MM-DD", time_rotating.ci.id)}"
  expires_at      = time_rotating.ci.unix + 60 * 86400

  lifecycle {
    create_before_destroy = true
  }
}

output "ci_token" {
  value     = devin_enterprise_service_user_api_key.rotating.token
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the API key.
- `service_user_id` (String) ID of an existing service user.

### Optional

- `expires_at` (Number) Expiration as a UNIX timestamp in seconds. Must be in the future when the key is created. The key does not expire when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `api_key_id` (String) API key ID (assigned by Devin).
- `created_at` (Number) Creation time as a UNIX timestamp in seconds.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The API token. Only available from the run that created the key.
